data.description:
## Description

**What**: Pre-sprint gate at tests/scripts/test-b-pre-sprint-gate.sh: verifies tests/audits/B-feasibility-spike-results.md is present in HEAD AND A0 (188c-47e4) PR is MERGED AND A2 (8623-8d6a) PR is MERGED before B's first story enters sprint. Drift from specced contracts during implementation triggers REPLAN_ESCALATE: brainstorm. Spike artifact captures both the 2026-05-07 concepts spike + 2026-05-08 decomposition+implementation spike findings, sample extractions for strata:application_form, and the 5 documented caveats.
**Why**: B builds on contracts from A0 + A2; pre-sprint gate prevents premature start.
**Scope**:
- IN: Spike-artifact authoring + commit (B-feasibility-spike-results.md); pre-sprint gate behavioral test (with/without artifact fixture); REPLAN_ESCALATE: brainstorm signal on contract drift.
- OUT: Brainstorm machinery for replan handling (existing infrastructure).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, tests/audits/B-feasibility-spike-results.md exists with both spike findings + 5 caveats + sample extractions ← Satisfies: epic In Scope
- When complete, tests/scripts/test-b-pre-sprint-gate.sh passes when artifact + A0 + A2 are present, fails otherwise ← Satisfies: epic In Scope
- When complete, contract-drift detection emits REPLAN_ESCALATE: brainstorm with explanation ← Satisfies: epic In Scope
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for the gate logic and drift detection

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Gate fails closed on missing artifact

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a sprint orchestrator, a pre-sprint gate enforces spike artifact + A0/A2 PRs merged before B's first story
